what_this_is: The SILENT-SUCCESS SENTINEL contract. A silent success is a parse that returns Ok with ZERO diagnostics while handing the consumer a PLACEHOLDER node instead of the shape the grammar's return annotation promised. Every 'did it parse?' gate is green on such a parse, which is precisely why a separate instrument is needed: the defect is invisible to acceptance testing by construction.
why_the_charter_inventory_was_not_enough: DONE-BAR.5c was chartered against the CODEGEN half of the sentinel family (<property_access> / <array_access> / <last_extraction>). MEASURED 2026-07-29: those literals occur 0 times across all 11 shipped generated parsers.

A gate asserting only their absence therefore passes today over an untouched tree and can NEVER fail -- the vacuity trap GENERATED-LINT-CORRECTNESS.3 named ('a generated-code gate that lints nothing and exits 0').

The SHIPPED sentinel surface is the RUNTIME half: 3702 fallback arms across 10 of the 11 shipped .rs artifacts (<invalid_sequence_access> 3016 in 10, <invalid_extraction_base> 343 in 5, <not_quantified> 343 in 5; only scratch_parser.rs is clean), a class with a PROVEN consumer-visible corruption history (ledger SV-0014..SV-0020, SVPP-0001, RTL-FE-0002, VHDL-0001, RTL-CE-0001; 9 reachable-corrupt SV sites fixed by SV-AST-SHAPE-FIDELITY).

⚠️ THE ARTIFACT ROSTER IS DERIVED FROM every generated/*.rs, NOT from a `*_parser.rs` suffix: generated/ebnf.rs is a shipped parser WITHOUT that suffix, and the suffix glob silently skipped its 123 <invalid_sequence_access> arms on this gate's own first run (reported 2893, ground truth 3016).
So the gate carries BOTH arms: a STATIC arm locking the codegen sentinels at absent, and a DYNAMIC arm that parses each family's own stimuli proof surface and fails on any sentinel actually reached.
honest_limit: The dynamic arm proves 'NOT REACHED by <sample_count> validated stimuli samples at the pinned seed', which is NOT a proof of unreachability. Reachability is entry-relative: SV-AST-SHAPE-FIDELITY.2.4 classified 7 sites as LATENT -- they DO emit a sentinel under --entry-rule isolation while being PEG-shadowed from the canonical entry. The gate states this bound in its own output rather than implying a stronger claim.

codegen_placeholder.detail: Emitted by codegen paths that cannot honour the construct they were handed and return Ok(...) anyway. DOCTRINE-GAP-OWNERSHIP.3 owns the site inventory (5 sites; the '6' recorded in DONE-BAR.5's bullet and MEMORY.md is a miscount, corrected 2026-07-29).

runtime_fallback.detail: Emitted INTO the generated parser as the fallthrough arm of a positional-model match. Reaching one means the consumer received a placeholder inside a successful parse.

sweep.why_module_carrier: The --generate-stimuli TEXT form joins samples with newlines and samples THEMSELVES contain newlines (measured: vhdl 3 samples over 158 lines), so it cannot be split correctly. The stimuli MODULE escapes them inside Rust string literals and is the only unambiguous carrier.
sweep.why_validate_parseability: It retries until every EMITTED sample is parser-ACCEPTED, which makes the faithfulness oracle 'every extracted sample must parse here' SOUND. Without it the module legitimately contains parser-rejected samples (measured: semantic_annotation, 2 rejected over 27 attempts) and a shortfall could not distinguish a duality break from an extractor bug.
sweep.generation_input: generated/<grammar>.json (the raw-AST JSON), NOT grammars/<grammar>.ebnf. MEASURED 2026-07-29: feeding the .ebnf requires ast_pipeline to be built with --features ebnf_dual_run, which the standard build -- including the one `make -C rust regenerate_generated_parsers` leaves behind -- does NOT enable, so the gate REFUSED for semantic_annotation and systemverilog immediately after a regeneration. The JSON is already a hard precondition of this gate (it refuses without generated/), so reading it removes the ambient-build dependency entirely. --grammar-profile still applies (sv_2017: 1352 rules vs 1475 unprofiled).

families.max_depth_reason: Its ~16-level precedence cascade FAILS at the default depth 24 ('depth exceeded while expanding primary_expr', reproduced at seeds 0/7/42 on both the .ebnf and raw-AST-JSON paths) and HANGS at >=40. 32 is the tuned window recorded by PARSE-HARNESS.5.5. A family whose window is wrong yields ZERO samples, so this value is load-bearing: without it the gate would REFUSE for this family rather than report a green zero.

calibration.what_this_is: GROUND TRUTH the instrument must reproduce before any verdict is offered. A detector with no positive control cannot tell a clean sweep from a blind one -- a zero would read as a pass either way. On mismatch the gate prints MISCALIBRATED and exits nonzero WITHOUT reporting a sweep result (the check_gate_reachability.sh precedent).

facts.why: The SVPP-0001 ledger repro. Released FIXED at 1.0.2, so a NONZERO count here means the fix regressed or the detector is misreading.

THE ARM THAT MATTERS. SV-AST-SHAPE-FIDELITY.2.4 classified this site LATENT: it DOES emit one sentinel under --entry-rule isolation. If this arm reads 0 the detector is BLIND and every clean sweep is worthless.

facts.input: class C; rand int x; constraint cc { this.x < 5; } endclass
facts.why: The same site from the CANONICAL entry, where the general SV expression grammar PEG-shadows it. Pins the LATENT classification itself: were this to become nonzero, a latent site had become reachable and the family's tier must fall.

refusals.what_this_is: Conditions under which the gate exits 2 (REFUSE) rather than 0. A skip is never a pass.
conditions: generated/ artifacts absent -- generated/ is UNTRACKED, so a clean checkout would sweep nothing and a naive gate would exit 0 over an empty room
a family in the roster generating ZERO samples (a wrong or absent generation window)
extracted sample count disagreeing with the module's own declared count
any calibration fact failing to reproduce (MISCALIBRATED)
